china_race_dynamics.text: AI tools of all kinds are readily available and some have the potential to support entrepreneurs. But I do worry that as tech giants race ahead to push out their next AI model, there is insufficient attention on the actual utility of this technology to our small business owners and, frankly, to the American people.

deepseek.reason: The statement criticizes tech giants' AI race but does not mention China or US-China competition.
deepseek.confidence_reason: No China or US-China competition is mentioned; the concern is about tech giants and utility.
